title: Gaymer Boys
description: This modpack is designed to enhance the core Minecraft experience by integrating a curated selection of Fabric mods focused on quality-of-life improvements, improved performance with drastically changing the base Minecraft experience.
body:
This modpack is a carefully curated collection of Fabric modifications designed to enrich and refine the traditional Minecraft experience without fundamentally altering its core gameplay. Our primary goal is to provide players with a more polished, user-friendly, and performant adventure that stays true to the spirit of vanilla Minecraft. This pack focuses on enhancing convenience, improving exploration, boosting performance, and providing useful in-game information, making your blocky world more engaging and efficient.

**What This Project Specifically Does or Adds**

This modpack integrates several client-side mods to achieve its purpose:

- Enhanced World Navigation:
	- Xaero's Minimap: Adds a dynamic, customizable minimap to your screen, providing real-time location, entity tracking, and waypoint management for easier navigation.

	- Xaero's World Map: Provides a full-screen, persistent world map that automatically records your exploration, displays waypoints, and gives you a comprehensive overview of your world.

- Streamlined Inventory and Item Management:
	- Inventory Sorting: Enables quick and efficient sorting of items within your inventory, chests, and other storage containers with simple keybinds.

	- Mouse Tweaks: Enhances mouse interactions for faster item manipulation in inventories, allowing for quick stack movements and item distribution.

	- DURABILITY Tooltip: Adds detailed and clear durability information directly to item tooltips, helping you monitor your tools and armor more effectively.

- Accelerated Resource Gathering:
	- Veinminer: Allows you to mine an entire connected vein of ores or a group of blocks (e.g., trees) by breaking only one block, drastically speeding up resource collection.

- Informative and Intuitive User Interface:
	- Jade: Provides detailed, contextual information about blocks and entities directly as you look at them, offering instant insights into their properties and uses.

	- Mod Menu: Integrates a user-friendly in-game interface to view all loaded mods and easily configure their individual settings without leaving the game.


- Quality of Life Utilities:
	- Sleep (v4.2.5+mod): Enhances the sleep mechanic, potentially allowing for single-player night skipping in multiplayer environments to improve gameplay flow.

	- Essential Commands: Adds a selection of useful client-side commands to provide additional in-game utilities and convenience.


- Core Modding Foundations:
	- Fabric Language Kotlin, Fabric API, Cloth Config API, SuperMartijn642's Config Lib, and Silk: These are essential underlying libraries and APIs that ensure the compatibility, stability, and proper function of all included mods within the Fabric ecosystem.


**Why Someone Should Want to Download This Project**


You should download the this modpack if you love the core Minecraft game but are looking for a more refined, efficient, and visually pleasing experience. This pack is perfect for players who:

- Seek easier navigation: Never get lost again with clear minimaps and world maps.

- Desire less tedious inventory management: Spend less time organizing and more time playing.

- Wish to speed up resource collection: Gather materials more efficiently with Veinminer.

- Appreciate helpful in-game information: Get instant details about blocks and entities without needing to consult external wikis.

- Prefer a subtle enhancement: This pack avoids major gameplay overhauls, preserving the vanilla feel while significantly boosting usability.

It's ideal for those who want a "Minecraft 2.0" experience that feels like a natural evolution of the game, rather than a completely different one.
